apps.localizedDescription:
@ipavault | KickUnblock

A native Kick client for iPhone and iPad. Live streams, VODs, clips and chat in a fast SwiftUI app. 

KickUnblock is an ad-free, open-source Kick viewer. It uses the same Amazon IVS player as Kick for livestreams. It uses Apple's player for VODs and clips. It keeps your follows and saved clips on your device. No account is needed to watch.
